resolutions.phrase: One week of soak misses the month-end batch; two weeks catches it.

referents.why: Introduces month-end batch coverage as a rationale contesting the settled one-week minimum soak duration.
Challenges Tanya's ratified formal decision that the soak between sites is one week, not two.
Challenges the proposal to reduce soak to one week based strictly on exception rate flattening.

resolutions.why: Tina directly engages the settled debate on soak duration between site cutovers, introducing month-end batch execution as a new basis requiring a two-week soak instead of the agreed one-week period.
